extension.summary: No scrolling. No deciding. Just watching.
extension.description: Tired of scrolling through your library wondering what to watch? EasyTV handles it. It tracks your shows and always knows your next episode. When you're ready for something new, it'll suggest a show you haven't started. Throw in some movies if you want. Just sit down, press play, and enjoy. Built for Kodi 21+.
extension.news:
v1.11.0 (2026-11-07) - New: white menu icons for EasyTV and its clones, for skins that let you pick a home menu icon - With debug logging on, the log now names the show or episode whose text holds an unusual character
v1.10.2 (2026-10-03) - Fixed Kodi crashing on every start (and ending in safe mode) when a title, plot or file path in your library contains an unusual character - Such characters now show as a placeholder symbol instead
v1.10.1 (2026-09-05) - Fixed fanart not showing in the Big Screen and Posters browse views - Documentation now shows every guided question with fresh screenshots
